name: Lucky Turkey

features.name: Accumulating multipliers
features.description: Multipliers build up during free spins.

review:
Thanksgiving in Nana's kitchen, made with Cream.Team. Symbols pay anywhere with refills.

In free spins the multipliers build up and never reset, so a long bonus can grow a lot. Chance x2 makes scatters more frequent for a 25% higher stake. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and a 97.17% RTP, with free spins about once every 163 spins. A seasonal version of the Gemhalla and Tramp Day engine.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
